newsitem.title: USA: Two injured as Delta flight's landing gear collapses.
newsitem.headline: Two injured as Delta flight's landing gear collapses.

text.p: The landing gear on a Delta Air Lines 727 airliner collapsed after landing Sunday at Albuquerque International Airport, slightly injuring two passengers, airport officials said.

Dennis Parker, assistant aviation director at Albuquerque International Airport, said the accident occurred at around 5 p.m. when Flight 3470's landing gear collapsed as it taxied to the gate on arrival from Dallas.
Parker said two people were injured when the plane's 148 passengers and crew were evacuated by inflatable escape shutes. Both were taken to an Albuquerque hospital but neither were seriously injured.
The incident did not cause long delays at the airport, he said.
